name: All new services MUST comply with the 10 principles of Secure by Design to ensure security is built-in from the outset.
conditionsText: When building services and making major changes
requirementTitle: All new services MUST comply with the 10 principles of Secure by Design to ensure security is built-in from the outset.
requirementDescription: When creating a new service, security must be considered from the beginning of the design process, rather than being added later as an afterthought.
why: Don't build a service first and worry about security later. Design and build security into the service from day one, following the Secure by Design principles.
tasks: All new services MUST comply with the 10 principles of Secure by Design to ensure security is built-in from the outset.

actions.title: All new services MUST comply with the 10 principles of Secure by Design to ensure security is built-in from the outset.
actions.description: Follow Secure by design principles and use the self assessment tracker to monitor progress

systems: All products and services built in house
